citations.title: AI Recruiting Explained: How the Pipeline Works & What It Costs (2026)
excerpts: # AI recruiting: *how the pipeline* actually works

Keyword filtering, vector embeddings, fine-tuned LLM vetting, live AI candidate conversations, and senior engineer interviews. This is how ON3 Works finds and validates technical talent across the UK and Spain — and why it takes 24–48 hours instead of 44 days.
Updated August 2026
![](https://on3works.com/team/john-kinloch-sq.jpg?v=20261001)By [John Kinloch](https://on3works.com/about), co-founder and CEO of ON3 Works
The short answer

AI recruiting replaces manual sourcing with machine matching. ON3 Works runs a three-stage AI pipeline — keyword filtering, vector embeddings, fine-tuned LLM vetting — across 1.7M+ UK and Spanish technical profiles, then a senior engineer interviews Atelier finalists. Roughly the top 2.5% reach the client. Fees: 7% or 20%, no deposit.
— The pipeline
## Three stages of AI, then an engineer

Most agencies that call themselves “AI-powered” have bolted a sourcing tool onto a manual desk. The recruiter is still the operating layer. ON3 Works is structured differently: AI is the operating layer that connects the database, the matching logic, the screening process, and the shortlist. The human is deployed at the point where judgement matters most — not spread across every step.

Candidates who pass the pipeline enter live AI-driven screening conversations via WhatsApp, phone and LinkedIn — extracting signals that CVs leave ambiguous. For Atelier placements, a senior domain-matched engineer (8–15+ years) interviews every finalist. Twelve-month retention across placements is 90.7%.

ON3 Works was designed this way from September 2022. It owns its sourcing infrastructure — the ON3 database of 1.7M+ structured profiles and hiron.ai (which ON3 also owns) — and runs the entire pipeline in-house. No rented databases. No third-party matching APIs.

basis.reasoning: The insights index primarily lists recruitment-fee, hiring, location, and salary research. Its AI recruiting pipeline explainer is one relevant technical post, authored by the co-founder, rather than the two technical posts required for a true answer.

© ON3 WORKS · EST. 2022

— INDEX 008 · QUESTIONS
## Straight
_answers._
01 What makes you different from a normal recruitment agency?

We are AI-native recruiters. Our process is built around proprietary AI, our own technical talent database, and a curated network of top developers and IT professionals across the UK and Spain. Traditional agencies often rely on LinkedIn searches, inbound applicants, and manual outreach. We combine AI search, structured data, network access, and technical recruiting judgment to find candidates who are already qualified.
02 What do you mean by "qualified candidates"?

A qualified candidate is someone with evidence of being able to do the actual work required. We assess for relevant technical experience, seniority, shipped systems, communication, availability, location, compensation fit, and motivation. For senior or critical roles, we can also add technical interviews run by experienced engineers.
03 Why do you focus on the UK and Spain?

The UK and Spain are two of our strongest technical markets. We have deep candidate coverage, strong network density, and local recruiting knowledge across both — giving us better access, faster shortlists, and stronger matching for companies hiring in or from those markets.
04 What kind of roles do you cover?

Engineering, development, and IT roles: backend, frontend, full-stack, platform, DevOps and cloud, data, ML and AI, cybersecurity, IT infrastructure, and staff, principal, and technical leadership roles.
05 Do you only use AI?

No. AI gives us speed, reach, and structured signal. Human judgment gives us quality control. The best results come from both — proprietary AI to map the market and technical recruiting expertise to decide who is actually worth your time.
06 How fast can we see candidates?

Most teams receive a first qualified shortlist within 24–48 hours. More senior, niche, or heavily vetted searches can take longer, but the process is designed to move faster than traditional technical recruiting.
07 How much does ON3 Works cost?

Agentic (AI-led speed): 7% of first-year base salary. Atelier (engineer-vetted): 20%. Both are pure success-fee — you pay only when a candidate is hired. No deposit, no retainer. A UK agency typically charges 15–25%: see [recruitment agency fees UK](https://on3works.com/resources/recruitment-agency-fees-uk) . For full details, see our [pricing page](https://on3works.com/pricing) .
08 What industries do you cover?

We specialise in software engineering, with growing strength in cybersecurity and deep tech (HPC, chips, embedded systems). Our clients range from YC-backed startups to enterprise organisations like CGI, across the UK and Spain.
